scope.matrix_entries: Generic residues B_ij; the identities also hold after original-amplitude or Fourier-phase substitutions.
scope.residual: B_SS + B_SK (I - E_K B_KK)^(-1) E_K B_KS
scope.reader: J_K = product_i (1 + eps_i pivot_i) = det(I - E_K B_KK)^(-1)
scope.terminal: [product_i eps_i] J_K L(residual), where L is the remaining terminal chain readout

verification_cost.representation: Explicit square-zero monomial dictionaries, up to 2^k scalar coefficients per entry.
verification_cost.jet_multiply_bound: At most 4^k examined coefficient pairs per call; overlapping masks are discarded.
verification_cost.determinant_oracle: Enumerates k! permutations; used only for finite independent verification.
verification_cost.terminal_oracle: Enumerates n! or (n-k)! assignments; used only for finite independent verification.
verification_cost.field_negation_cost_convention: One multiplication by the constant -1 if translated into ordinary scalar gates.
verification_cost.counter_scope: Verifier computations including independent oracles; not a bound for a general compiler.
